biotools.summary: NCI-Profiler (NCIP) automatically detects and visualizes protein–ligand non-covalent interactions: hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, salt bridges, π–π stacking, cation–π, halogen bonds, metal coordination (with τ4/τ5 geometry analysis), water bridges and halogen–water–hydrogen (XWH) bridges. It takes PDB/mmCIF files or PDB IDs without manual preparation, handles multi-ligand and macrocyclic ligands, and produces editable 2D diagrams, an in-browser Mol* 3D view, PyMOL sessions and JSON/CSV/TXT output. Available as a free web server and a dependency-free Python CLI/API.
